meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: Claude 会在你的 macOS 菜单栏装一个闪电图标,用绿点/红点显示 NanoClaw 是否在运行,并提供启动、停止、重启控制,还能打开日志。它会先检查环境,再编译 Swift 二进制、创建 launchd 服务并验证是否生效。
howto.when: 当你要求为 NanoClaw 添加 macOS 菜单栏状态指示器时接管。仅支持 macOS,且需要已安装 Xcode 命令行工具(swiftc);不满足时它会停下并说明原因。

howto.what_en: Claude installs a bolt icon in your macOS menu bar showing a green or red dot for whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. It compiles the Swift binary, creates a launchd service, and verifies it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. macOS only, and it needs Xcode Command Line Tools (swiftc); otherwise it stops and explains.
